critic_risk_flags: Fractional memory is not clearly justified by the series summary (single season, n_train=31) and adds flexibility that can mimic delay/waning effects, increasing overfitting and identifiability risk. Given the explicit risk note about weak identifiability in short series, adding fractional dynamics on top of SEIRS+delay is more likely to create parameter tradeoffs (memory vs. delay vs. waning) than to reflect a well-supported mechanism.
